simple.meaning: שַׁעֲרַיִם (Shaʻărayim) is a place-name in the Hebrew text (H8189). BibleIQ follows its 3 occurrences across Scripture.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.

timeline.evidenceText: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.

The men of Israel and of Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as Gai and to the gates of Ekron. The wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even to Gath and to Ekron.
at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.

definitions.full: H8189. Shaarayim שַׁעֲרַ֫יִם proper name, of a location 1 in the Shephelah of Judah (Buhl Geogr. 194 ) Josh 15:36 , Σακαρειμ , ᵐ5 L Σεβαρειμ ; שׁ ׳דֶּרֶךְ 1Sam 17:52 ( ᵐ5 τῶν πυλῶν ). 2 in the Negeb (Simeon), וּבְשַׁעֲרָ֑יִוֺ 1Chr 4:31 , Σεωρειμ , ᵐ5 L Σααριμ ; = שָׁרוּחֶ֑ן (q. v.) Josh 19:6 , and perhaps שִׁלְחִיוֺ (in Negeb of Judah) 15:32 ; Buhl Geogr. m. 185 .
